purpose: Teach: 賠償/失業/暴力団/ヒトラー/文部省/王朝/満州/殺す

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦後の、本気で、絶対、賠償、絶対、政策、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Ren, your paper on postwar compensation policy was really impressive. I was genuinely moved by how seriously you engaged with it.
lines.style: Warm, measured appreciation. Slight pause before the praise lands. Not effusive—genuine recognition from someone who reads carefully. Clear-eyed and steady.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。世界恐慌期の、本気で、絶対、失業、絶対、問題、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you so much. I was really interested in unemployment during the Great Depression, and I tried to make the research as thorough as I could. I'm grateful for your guidance.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity. Respectful but not stiff. The careful articulation of someone choosing words that matter. Slight breath before the thanks—genuine deference without diminishing himself.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦後の、本気で、絶対、暴力団、絶対、対策、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: And the way you handled yakuza countermeasures in the postwar period—your perspective was really broad. Genuinely impressive work.
lines.style: Thoughtful, observant tone. A small nod of recognition in the voice. Not praising the topic but the thinking behind it. Steady eye-contact level.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。第二次世界大戦の、本気で、絶対、ヒトラー、絶対、政権、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I spent a lot of time on the World War II period, especially the Hitler regime and its structures. I tried to go as deep as I could, and your feedback meant a lot to me.
lines.style: Earnest and focused. The cadence of someone laying out careful work. Not seeking more praise but acknowledging the effort it took. Slight lift at the end—genuine.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦前の、本気で、絶対、文部省、絶対、教育政策、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Your treatment of prewar education ministry policy was really something. Genuinely impressive scope.
lines.style: Attentive and warm. The voice of someone who has read closely and is marking a moment worth noting. Not overstating it—just clear recognition. Brief, weighted.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。古代の、本気で、絶対、王朝、絶対、政治史、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I looked at ancient dynasty and political history across a long period. I wanted to make sure the research was solid, and your guidance really helped me do that.
lines.style: Quiet focus. The measured pace of someone who thinks before speaking. Respectful, not obsequious. A small but genuine smile underneath—he means the thanks.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦前の、本気で、絶対、満州、絶対、開拓史、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The way you tackled prewar Manchuria and its settlement history—really thorough work. I was genuinely impressed by the depth you brought to it.
lines.style: Reflective and steady. A slight lean forward in the voice—this one matters. Clear recognition of difficulty attempted and achieved. Warm without condescension.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。歴史的に、本気で、絶対、王朝が、絶対、政敵を、絶対、殺す、絶対、事例、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I researched historical cases where ruling dynasties eliminated political opponents—it's a pattern that kept appearing. I tried to handle it carefully, and I really appreciate your support through the process.
lines.style: Careful and serious. The weight of a difficult subject in his voice, but not heavy-handed. Respectful of the material and of his teacher's attention. Steady gratitude at the close.
